reviews.title: Disappointed in the watch overall.
reviews.text: We do not have the phone, but I did get a watch for my nine-year-old. The location tracking and the ability to text or call are limited. Often the location can’t be determined or if it does track her location, it shows she is 7 blocks away from her actual location. Unfortunately, the text and phone calls are spotty as well I often cannot get through to her until she’s actually with me, and then the watch will alert her that she received my calls or messages. Troubleshooting is very difficult because you cannot talk to a live agent. It’s an AI bot chat only. We’ve had this for a month, and now I’m stuck with a watch payment, and failing attempts at canceling a useless subscription. I am extremely disappointed after seeing so many online reviews and reels that tempted me to purchase this for her safety.

The app has been needing a new update almost every dang week since we got the phones a few months ago.  So if they are at their dad’s house when it needs updated, they have to go without monitoring until i can get their phones back days later.  Half the time i dont even get notified that the app needs updated.  My 8 year old just got caught by her dad today with an adult book app on her phone.  Was not notified at all by the app that she had even downloaded a new app on her own or that she was looking at that rated material.  Go to look on my end and the app needs updated AGAIN.  So her phone is just taken away and i have no contact with her anymore while she is at her dads because obviously we can’t give the phone back unprotected.  Bark has been such a hassle and seems poorly set up.

The watch is insured but because it’s not broken, insurance doesn’t cover it but they don’t seem concerned about the tech not working. I’m going to give it another month but I may be canceling and switching to a different option if this doesn’t get resolved. I need to be able to track my 9 year old’s location for after school activities and if that feature isn’t working then I can’t stay with the brand which is really disappointing as I’d planned to stick with them through high school for both my kids and that may not be possible if the products and tech don’t work.

reviews.title: Confusing setup

Extremely disappointing and frustrating.

Edit: thanks for the response and offer for support. I have an email chain that is 50 messages long with your support regarding overall confusion of setup and my end goal of simply monitoring safari activity. This entire experience was a complete waste of time for a service that is misleading and confusing.

reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this company and would not recommend them.

The software itself has been unreliable. It frequently lags, and one of the main reasons for buying a kids’ smartwatch—being able to see your child’s live location—doesn’t work properly most of the time. The previous watch we had from them also used to ring randomly for no apparent reason.

On top of these technical problems, I returned the watch in good condition, but the company later charged me claiming that it was broken. To the best of my knowledge, there was no damage to the watch when I packaged and returned it.

Overall, I’m very unhappy with both the product quality and the way the return was handled. Based on my experience, I would be very cautious about buying from this company.

reviews.title: Doesn’t support iPad
reviews.text:
I was fooled. I bought into these glowing reviews. I bought a yearly subscription and the $50 sync module only to find after HOURS of fiddling with our iPads and never getting it to sync that they are having “issues with getting it to connect with iPads…” and instead of being transparent from the get go - I was told either I could get a refund or work with their engineers to “figure it out.” NO THANKS. 
So if you have an issue, there’s no phone number to call, you only have an AI bot that is slow and freezes when it eventually lets you to a human - I had to keep my phone in front of hoping to catch someone as it literally takes 10+ mins for a reply up to hours later, which then times out. 
If you email support they don’t listen / read and pass you along to other support and you start from square one. 
When used Bark without Sync (monitors some things sans sync) - my kids complained of their tablet being slow since it’s via VPN - it monitored Roblox and slow it down/freeze. It also would block odd things on the tablet so I spent a lot of time fiddling with it. It monitors YouTube which thought nearly every video was somehow inappropriate - but when I watched it, it wasn’t, for instance it dinged a cartoon dancing as possible sexual? It’s like an overzealous granny is monitoring it. First red flag was how much time I spent messing with all the settings just to give some freedom and noticing how the iPad slowed down. With the GARBAGE customer service that’s hard to get a hold of

reviews.title: Reviewing app + phone
reviews.text:
We have had a bark phone since last August. While the monitoring is decent, we’ve had a few issues and I’m pretty over it at this point. 

If my child gets too many messages at a time, the phone lags badly and even freezes at times. If my child tries to mark a chat as “unread” so they can go back to it later, it won’t do it. If I give permissions to delete messages so we can clear the phone, the messages won’t actually delete. After the bark app glitched a few months back, some chats are available for my child to open no matter what routine I have set up for that time. The phone has been stuck on dark mode & battery saver mode since we got it and we don’t even have access on the phone to adjust battery settings. The longer we have the phone, the worse the location tracking is. And the most recent thing, a beta thing was added to the app. “Advanced insights” they call it. It is the most invasive addition to this and the fact that it is forced on us 1) without asking if we want to be part of it beforehand and 2) giving us the option to opt out makes it immensely worse. I’m just so disappointed in our experience.
